(1): H = -t sum_<R,R'>,s c+c - t' sum_<<R,R'>>,s (c+c + H.c.) + U sum n_up n_dn, so t2 = t' = +0.05 in the instance convention (as for the existing t'/t = 0.1 ... 0.25 rows from the same table). Table 2 is for U/t = 12, 'Data are shown for Lx = 48' (Lx = 40 only for lambda = 5), ladders L = Lx x 6 'with periodic boundary conditions along both the x and the y directions' (288-site torus, instance rectangular-6x48), doping delta = 1/8 (delta = 1 - n), so 252 electrons and Nf = 126 per spin. Energy per site in units of t, no conversion. 'The error bar on the energy is always smaller than 10^-4' is one statement for the whole table, not a per-value sigma, so sigma is null. Implied, not stated (RULES.md 8): the row label of Table 2 reads 't'/t = 0.5' between the rows 0 and 0.1; the value is t'/t = 0.05. Evidence: the t'/t column steps by 0.05 (-0.5 ... -0.1, 0, [0.5], 0.1, 0.15, 0.20, 0.25) and every other column is monotone only for 0.05: E_stripe -0.6255, -0.6309, -0.6375, -0.6464, -0.6562, -0.6669; E_uniform -0.6227, -0.6283, -0.6355, -0.6447, -0.6553, -0.6669; Delta E -0.0028, -0.0026, -0.0020, -0.0017, -0.0009, 0; wavelengths lambda = 6, 8, 8, 12, 12, 12. A true t'/t = 0.5 would sit after 0.25 and has an energy per site below -0.6669 (the energy falls with t' over the printed range); the printed -0.6309 is above it. The check E_stripe - E_uniform = -0.6309 - (-0.6283) = -0.0026 equals the printed Delta E.
